e2e.method: Full local suite, followed by targeted regressions and final Studio tests. Latest outcome per browser/file/title. Initial failed cases were fixed and rerun.

skipped.test: projects › the wizard creates a named project whose materials stay apart from other projects
preview preferences restore from the URL and keyboard panel resizing does not alter documents

limitations: Headless desktop browsers and mobile viewport emulation; no physical device.
WebKit/Safari not run: existing system-library limitation.
Contrast check covers semantic primary/secondary text on panel and raised surfaces, not every image/material.
Vite reports the editor chunk above 500 kB. No new dependency introduced.
